# The pasted examples that ARE executed by a test through the comparator
# (onboarding.Compare, directly or via onboarding.Execute), per SPEC-TOOLWORK §7
# rule 7. One per line: `<test file>:<TestName> <the $ line, exactly as pasted>`.
#
# TestIssue2218 checks every entry: the $ line is a real pasted example, the
# named file declares the named test, and that file reaches the comparator and
# reads the doc the line is pasted in. An example is in this file or in
# unexecuted_examples.txt, never both. Moving a line from unexecuted_examples.txt
# to here is how that list shrinks.

cmd/nova-sprint/table_test.go:TestTheCommandReferenceFirstRunMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-sprint table --once
cmd/nova-sprint/table_test.go:TestTheCommandReferenceFirstRunMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-sprint table --once --out sprint-table.txt
cmd/nova-sprint/table_test.go:TestTheCommandReferenceFirstRunMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-sprint table --check
cmd/nova-wake/presence_test.go:TestTheCommandReferencePresenceExampleMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-wake presence --store 100.115.99.19:6380 --bus ./bus
